resources.string: Inspects technical screen labels and view IDs only in the apps you choose (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, Snapchat, Reddit, or custom apps) strictly on-device to recognize Shorts, Reels, For You, Spotlight, or Watch feeds, show pause controls or return to the app’s Home tab, and track local limits. Messages, passwords, and videos are never read, stored off-device, or shared. Turn off anytime here.
